author: QteeKitty
quote: 13 years of waiting and $100 dollars down the drain, I can easily say that the previous games in this franchise were significantly better and far less buggy. Genuinely unplayable and not worth the money. With the same graphics from GTA V, less playability, and a story that’s just not compelling, I wouldn’t even play it if it was the last video game on earth. Did not live up to the hype and disappointed me.

author: QteeKitty
quote: This is the game of the year, 100%! Even with it being a remake of an older game, it still holds that magical feel of a new game. I wish I could forget all about this game to play it with a clear mind and fall in love with it again!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
